description: Add a website URL for the agent to crawl into its knowledge base. Returns the entry with its id and crawl status. Crawling is asynchronous - the knowledge is not available immediately; poll mba_get_website for crawl_status.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

name: mba_create_website
title: Add a website to crawl
